Klasse Recipe

java.lang.Object
org.schmuh.quisine.entity.Recipe
@Entity public class Recipe extends Object
Entity class representing a recipe in the recipe system.

This class is mapped to the "Recipe" table in the database, where each record represents a recipe. The class uses JPA annotations to define the mapping between the entity and the database table.

  • id: The unique identifier for the recipe (primary key). Generated automatically.
  • title: The title of the recipe.
  • description: A detailed description of the recipe (stored as a large object).
  • tags: A set of Tag objects representing the tags associated with the recipe. This is a many-to-many relationship.
  • ingredients: A set of RecipeIngredient objects representing the ingredients used in the recipe. This is a one-to-many relationship, where each recipe can have multiple ingredients.
  • personAmount: The number of servings the recipe yields.
  • timeEffort: The estimated time required to prepare the recipe, in minutes.
  • instructions: Step-by-step instructions for preparing the recipe (stored as a large object).
  • imageSrc: The source path or URL for the recipe's image (stored as a large object).

Annotations:

  • Entity - Marks this class as a JPA entity that will be mapped to a database table.
  • Table - Specifies the name of the database table ("Recipe") and the unique constraint on the "id" column to ensure it is unique.
  • Id - Marks the primary key field of the entity.
  • GeneratedValue - Specifies the strategy for generating the ID value (auto-incremented).
  • Ungültige Referenz 
    LOB
    - Marks fields as large objects (used for large text or binary data like descriptions and instructions).
  • ManyToMany - Defines a many-to-many relationship between the Recipe and Tag entities.
  • OneToMany - Defines a one-to-many relationship between the Recipe and RecipeIngredient entities. The relationship is mapped by the "recipe" field in the RecipeIngredient entity, with cascading operations and orphan removal enabled.
